messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I don’t have the will terms or an appraisal. I want a fair financial share and won’t subsidize A’s discounted purchase. I’d like this settled, but I’m not in a hurry. I can’t speak for B about whether she needs money.
I don’t have the will or appraisal. A fair outcome means I get a fair financial share; I haven’t agreed to subsidize A’s discounted purchase. I’d like it settled, but there’s no rush.

My husband and I would like to buy the house, with him as a co-owner. I think a family discount makes sense for a family sale, but I know C disagrees and I need her agreement. We haven’t settled on a price or timeline, and I don’t have the will terms or an appraisal.
I’d like some money to help start a dance studio, though I don’t know what amount might be available or fair. I don’t have the will terms or an appraisal, and I don’t have a particular deadline.
Changes: yes to getting the will and an independent appraisal. I do not agree to a discounted sale or to A’s husband becoming co-owner. I need the facts before deciding anything, and there’s no rush.
Yes to getting the will terms and an independent appraisal first. I’m not agreeing to a price or sale route yet. I want my husband as co-owner, and I don’t have a check-in date to suggest.

The steps seem reasonable as a starting point. I can’t name a studio amount or deadline until we know what funds may be available, and I’m not sure whether A’s husband being a co-owner raises a concern for me.

I don’t know who has the will or who the executor is. Yes to getting the will terms and an independent appraisal first. I need those facts before deciding; I still don’t agree to a discount or A’s husband as co-owner. No rush.

I don’t know who has the will or who the executor is. I agree we should request the will terms and get an independent appraisal first, but I can’t name a requester or date yet. I still want my husband as co-owner and am not considering buying without him. I think a family discount could be fair, but no price is set. I don’t have a check-in date; being twins or younger doesn’t establish what the will says.

I don’t know who has the will or who the executor is, but I’m willing to ask for the will terms. I could help request an independent appraisal, though I don’t have a date to propose yet. The plan seems fine as a starting point; I can’t name a studio amount or deadline before we know what funds may be available.
